title: Jenna Bush Hager's Daughter Accused Her of Using AI for Photo of a Falcon Perched on the Terrified Anchor's Head: 'Because When Does That Happen?'
source_used: AOL.com, carrying the text of OK! Magazine
key_facts: Jenna Bush Hager, co-host of TODAY With Jenna and Sheinelle, said on the 16 Oct 2026 episode, broadcast live from Ireland, that her 11-year-old daughter Poppy thought her photo was made with AI.
The photo shows a falcon named James perched on Bush Hager's head during a falconry session with co-host Sheinelle Jones.
The bird was meant to land only on the gloved arm; the expert said it lands on the glove 99 percent of the time and sometimes on the person.
Bush Hager said she is not a fan of birds landing on her and asked: "No, because when does a bird land on somebody's head?"
The production team kept showing the photo to the audience, which Bush Hager called "kind of mean".
quote_evidence: "I sent that to my kids and Poppythought it was AI," Bush Hager revealed about her 11-year-old daughter.
"No, because when does a bird land on somebody’s head?" Bush Hager said.
"James 99 percent of the time lands on the glove," the expert told them.
why_it_matters_hint: A light moment showing that people now suspect even real photos of being AI-made.
notes: The AOL page ends with OK! Magazine sign-up lines, so OK! Magazine is treated as the original outlet; its own link was not found, so the AOL page is the url. Poppy's age comes from the text (11-year-old daughter).
